title: Returning to the Reno Club and hearing Jo Jones
summary: Back after six months, Leeman hears the Basie band with Jo Jones, finds the music overwhelming and is told to play brushes on the next set.

story.theme_name: Playing with Count Basie: joining, leading, leaving
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: Who were some of the drummers, Cliff? Do you remember?

No. Some of the people I did not know their names. The piano player, Jay McShann could tell you -- he knew everybody. I didn't get to know him that good, but he was forming bands in those days. I can't put my finger on them, though -- my memory isn't all that good.
Well, you tell it your way.
Well of course, Jo Jones would be there, and then this other drummer whose name ...
Was Jonathan Jones there? What year was this when Jo was there?

Well, you see, I left -- this is '34 going on '35 -- I left after my first induction into the Reno Club, and this wonderful music, this wonderful band; when I came back six months later, I came back with all intentions, I'm improving as a kid and as a musician, and I'm still with Dan Murphy's Musical Skippers, going in on '35. I came back with all intentions of sitting down with this band, and really with my improved drumming, making a display of myself.

Well, I walked into the Reno Club one night and sat down, and the band came slowly on the stand, and all of a sudden, I heard the God damnest sounds that I ever heard in my life. This band, as everybody who was

around Kansas City at the time will tell you, it's impossible to tell people how awe inspiring it was. Jo Jones will tell you and those people that are fortunate enough to still be alive -- the music was just too much, it was too much to absorb.

And [Ray Benner], garbled Basit, said you're coming up to play some brushes on the next set, and I said, never -- you know, I had just heard Jo Jones and I didn't know anything existed like this. Now I never told that to many people.
Jo has always said so many beautiful things about you. It's nice to hear you say all of this.
